Here's what she sent, and what he replied 🤍

Her (11:42 PM): "I was looking forward to tonight. I'm not going to wait by the phone. Take care."
Him (12:03 AM): "You're right. I messed up. Tomorrow, 8 PM. I'll be at your door at 7:55."

He knocked at 7:50. With flowers. She never had to chase him again.

Why it works: She didn't beg, accuse or ask why. She said how she felt and stopped waiting, on her terms. Calm boundaries get respect; long paragraphs get left on read.

The words come from "What Do I Text Back?". All 3 dateunoa ebooks are in my bio if you want the rest.
